completeNativeProtectiveMutations.name: Protective Mutations
completeNativeProtectiveMutations.rangeAndTarget: Allies within 5 feet while you have at least one active mutation
completeNativeProtectiveMutations.effect: Protective Mutations. While at least one mutation is active, each ally other than you within 5 feet reduces the first damage it takes each round by S, minimum 0. Multiple Protective Mutations do not stack. The protection ends immediately when the ally leaves the aura or you have no active mutation.

source.originalText: Protective Mutations: Your mutations generate a 5-foot aura that grants allies +10% damage resistance.

completeNativeGuardianTissue.name: Guardian Tissue
completeNativeGuardianTissue.effect: Guardian Tissue. When an adjacent ally would take damage, reduce that ally's incoming damage by one-third rounded down. You take the prevented amount as damage of the same type. This transferred damage cannot be redirected again and cannot trigger another Guardian Tissue. Transferred damage cannot be reduced again, redirected again or generate BT.

source.originalText: Guardian Tissue: When an adjacent ally would take damage, you can absorb 30% of it as a reaction.
